_comment: Phase-6 party-bar name romanization for PACKDATA R2654 (2654_type44.raw) sub 7 (off 0x008210, the character/NPC name-value roster). Each premade-party / NPC name is stored as a katakana NAME-VALUE run (codec: glyph = name_val - 95; 193-238 = katakana grid). The party bar renders these runs through the R2100 page-0 font, which ALSO contains ASCII glyphs at glyph indices 0-94 (verified from GS-VRAM atlas tbp=0x2840). Romanization writes ASCII glyph indices encoded as name_val = ascii_gid + 95 (ascii_gid from data/english_glyph_table.json), which the same -95 codec resolves to R2100 page-0 ASCII cells. Entries are matched by their decoded katakana via data/name_labels.json. byte-length is NOT preserved per-entry (ASCII names differ in length from katakana runs); sub 7 is rebuilt with a fresh offset table (same container format as build/inject_r34_db.py build_sub) and other R2654 subs are left byte-identical.

_encoding.container: 44-sub header (16B LE: idx,size,off,z). sub 7 = name roster.
_encoding.sub_entry_table: BE u16 count, BE u16 0, count*(BE u16 off_rel, BE u16 pad); last pad=FFFF
_encoding.entry_body: BE u16 glyph/name-value run + FFFE + FFFF
_encoding.name_value_for_ascii: name_val = english_glyph_table[char] + 95  (renderer computes glyph = name_val - 95 -> R2100 page-0 ASCII cell)
_encoding.katakana_base: name_val 193-238 (untouched entries keep their original katakana runs)

_render_font: R2100 (2100_type04.raw) page 0, tbp=0x2840, PSMT4 256x256 CT32 -- ASCII at glyph 0-94, katakana at 97+. Confirmed via build/recon_v86/gs-vram-atlas atlas.json/summary.txt + page-0 atlas PNG.
_premade_party_note: Of the requested premade party (Ia/Vera/Konde/Basco/Erika/Freesia), only Vera, Konde, Erika exist in this R2654 sub-7 roster. 'Ia' (name_values [194,193]) is a guild/player slot stored elsewhere in R2654 (e.g. 0x2bafc) and already renders romanized in-game. 'Basco' and 'Freesia' have no entry in this table (entry 44 = Scone, not Basco; no Freesia entry). The full resolvable NPC roster is romanized below for party-bar/roster consistency.
